Analysis Description (Incl.What to Look: What style imagery is used most frequentyly in the asset, from the sample tagging provided?
Sample Tagging: Lifestyle (e.g. featuring people); Product lie flat; Product in use; Product on-model

Analysis Description (Incl.What to Look: If lifestyle creative, how would you decribe the scene?
Does the creative containt product-only imagery?
Does the creative feature the product in use?
Does the creative feature a before & after asset?
Does the PDP feature a benefit tile?
Does the creative include a shade-finder?
What color is used in the background of the creative?
What category of product does the creative relate to?
Sample Tagging: E.g. for a beauty brand, categories may include the following: lip; foundation; moisturizer; eye; etc

Analysis Description (Incl.What to Look: If a model is used, what is their inferred gender?
What type of creative asset is this between the sameple tagging types provided?
Sample Tagging: paid advertisement; product image carosel; retail product detail page; retail brand store; DTC website homepage; DTC product detail page; DTC category page; etc

Analysis Description (Incl.What to Look: If a model is used, how would you decribe the model demongraphically?
If the creative is for Fragrance, is an ingredient tile featured?
Notes: To highlight scent and notes of Fragrance in ATF

Analysis Description (Incl.What to Look: Is text overlaid on the creative, yes or no?
What is a summary of the text that is overlaid?
What type of call to action (CTA) is used, if any?
Sample Tagging: buy now, learn more, click to call, etc.

Analysis Description (Incl.What to Look: What text is used in this call to action (CTA)?
If longform copy is used, for example within descriptive content on a page, does it leverage bulleted lists or other ways to highlight common or different themes?
Does the PDP feature how-to-use instructions?
If any Amazon PDP - is there a minimum of 5 feature bullets?
Does the creative contain a brand logo?
Does the creative feature #1 or best-seller type claims?
Are any awards or badges included within the creative?
Are certifications featured on the creative or in copy (i.e., Vegan, dermatologist-tested)?
Is there an ingredient tile featured on the PDP?
Are the ingredients called out in the description or feature bullets?
If this is for a specific product, what variant of that product is featured?
Sample Tagging: Will vary, for example a specific color-way or product use case

Analysis Description (Incl.What to Look: Is price featured in the creative, yes or no?
What is the specific product, if any, the asset is being used to promote?
Notes: This will not be relevant if assessing creative for multiple products, like a multi-product ad campaign, brand store, homepage, or category page

Analysis Description (Incl.What to Look: What is the category of the offer?
Sample Tagging: Percentage Off; Dollar Amount Off; Buy One Get One (BOGO); Gift With Purchase; etc

Analysis Description (Incl.What to Look: Does the offer include a discount to the price, yes or no?
If the offer is a discount (e.g. price reduction); what is that level of discount as a percentage of the price?
If this is a paid advertisement, what type of ad is it?
Sample Tagging: static banner ad; video ad; rich media ad; carosel ad; etc.

Analysis Description (Incl.What to Look: Does the brand store feature a hero banner?
Does the brand store reature category navigation tiles?
Does the brand store feature shoppable images?
Is there clear product grouping (collections/categories) outlined on the brand store?
Are there cross-sell or up sell assets featured on the brand store?
Notes: Cross-sell of collections within the same brand

Analysis Description (Incl.What to Look: Does the ad visually stand out vs typical feed content?
Are high-contrast colors, motion, or unexpected visuals used?
Is the core message understandable instantly?
Is the brand identifiable quickly (within 3 seconds)?
What was the format of the ad?
Is the value prop clear in the ad?
Is there a call to action present in the ad creative?
What is the CTA type?
Can the agent join creative tags to performance outcomes per asset?
Sample Tagging: Impressions, Clicks, CTR, CVR, ROAS/ACOS, Units Sold, Attributed Sales, Detail Page Views, Add-to-Cart rate, Glance Views

Analysis Description (Incl.What to Look: What engagement metrics are available for PDP and Brand Store assets?
Sample Tagging: Dwell time, scroll depth, sub-page click-through, module-level click rate, hot-spot engagement

Analysis Description (Incl.What to Look: Is the creative optimized for mobile rendering and the mobile fold?
Sample Tagging: mobile_optimized: true | false; text_legible_at_thumbnail: true | false; key_info_above_mobile_fold: true | false

Analysis Description (Incl.What to Look: Are all required aspect ratios delivered (1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:5)?
Does the video hook viewers in the first 3 seconds and maintain pacing?
Sample Tagging: hook_strength: strong | moderate | weak; product_reveal_timing_seconds: <number>; cuts_per_second: <number>

Analysis Description (Incl.What to Look: Are captions or burned-in text present for sound-off viewing?
Sample Tagging: captions_present: true | false; caption_type: burned_in | closed | none

Analysis Description (Incl.What to Look: What is the video duration and does it fit retailer specs?
Does the asset include alt text and meet color contrast standards on text overlays?
Sample Tagging: alt_text_present: true | false; contrast_ratio_passes_wcag_aa: true | false

Analysis Description (Incl.What to Look: How long has the asset been live and is performance decaying?
Sample Tagging: date_launched: YYYY-MM-DD; days_live: <number>; frequency: <number>; performance_trend: improving | stable | declining

Analysis Description (Incl.What to Look: Is this asset part of an A/B test? Control or treatment?
Sample Tagging: test_id: <string>; variant_role: control | treatment_a | treatment_b | none; test_hypothesis: <string>

Analysis Description (Incl.What to Look: Is the asset tied to a specific event, season, or tentpole moment?
Sample Tagging: event: Prime Day | Black Friday | Cyber Monday | Walmart Deals | Valentines | Mothers Day | Back to School | Holiday | Evergreen | other

Analysis Description (Incl.What to Look: Does the creative follow or break category visual conventions? Is there a competitive comparison?
Sample Tagging: follows_category_conventions: true | false; competitive_comparison_present: true | false
